items.title: A notification for you, Apple: There is no husband
items.raw_content: Hello! How many pairs of long underwear does one pack for the Swiss Alps in January? Asking for a soon-to-be-frostbitten friend. 🥶 Yes, I’m headed to the World Economic Forum’s annual event in Davos, where I’ll be interviewing executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Uber and more. Stay tuned for coverage in next week’s edition. But first, this week: Why Apple’s AI notification summaries keep getting things wrong and what the company is doing about it. Then the latest on TikTok’s ban, Sonos’s app mess and Samsung’s new phones. 📱💥 Plus: Have ChatGPT proactively chat you up.
items.title_zh: 给 Apple 的通知：根本没有丈夫
items.summary: A newsletter preview says it examines why Apple's AI notification summaries keep getting things wrong and what the company is doing about it, alongside items on the TikTok ban, Sonos's app troubles and Samsung's new phones.

items.title: Show HN: Doom (1993) in a PDF

items.summary: The developer used an older Emscripten version to compile a Doom source port to asm.js so it runs inside a PDF reader's limited JavaScript runtime, drawing each frame as ASCII characters in rows of text fields.

items.summary: Douyin denied a claim about international registration and removed more than 10,000 fake foreign user accounts, TechNode reports.

items.summary: According to a report by IThome, major Xiaohongshu shareholders are in talks to sell part of their holdings, with companies including Tencent among potential buyers.

items.summary: FlowDown is a Swift project linked to flowdown.ai, according to its GitHub repository.

items.summary: A Python project that uses AI large models to generate high-definition story short videos in one click, according to its repository description.

items.title_zh: Faceplugin 开源人脸识别 SDK
items.summary: This open-source Python SDK from Faceplugin bundles face recognition, liveness detection, anti-spoofing, detection, landmarks, comparison, matching, pose, expression, and attribute tools.

items.summary: FlashSpace is a fast virtual workspace manager for macOS, written in Swift.

items.title: tinyauthapp/tinyauth
items.title_zh: tinyauthapp/tinyauth：极简的 OpenID 认证与授权服务器
items.summary: Tinyauth is a minimal OpenID-certified server for authorization and authentication, written in Go.

items.title: JSONSchemaBench: A Rigorous Benchmark of Structured Outputs for Language Models
items.title_zh: JSONSchemaBench：面向语言模型结构化输出的严格基准
items.summary: The paper introduces JSONSchemaBench, a benchmark of 10,000 real-world JSON schemas for evaluating constrained decoding, and tests six frameworks including Guidance, Outlines, Llamacpp, XGrammar, OpenAI and Gemini.

items.title: Counteracting temporal attacks in Video Copy Detection
items.title_zh: 抵御视频复制检测中的时序攻击
items.summary: The authors analyze the Dual-level detection method that won the META AI video copy detection challenge, finding weaknesses in its video editing detection component and under temporal attacks. They propose selecting frames at local peaks in interframe differences, reporting efficiency gains and better robustness with comparable micro-average precision.

items.title: Federated Testing (FedTest): A New Scheme to Enhance Convergence and Mitigate Adversarial Attacks in Federating Learning
items.title_zh: FedTest：提升联邦学习收敛性并缓解对抗攻击的新方案
items.summary: The paper introduces FedTest, a federated learning framework in which each user trains on local data and tests other users' models, producing scores used to aggregate models and flag malicious ones. Numerical results reportedly show faster convergence and less influence from malicious users.

items.title: Advancing Student Writing Through Automated Syntax Feedback
items.title_zh: 用自动句法反馈提升学生写作
items.summary: The authors build Essay-Syntax-Instruct, a dataset for English syntax feedback, and fine-tune GPT-3.5-Turbo, Llama-2 and Mistral-7B models on it, reporting improved ability to identify and correct students' syntactic errors.

items.title: Selective Attention Merging for low resource tasks: A case study of Child ASR
items.title_zh: 面向低资源任务的选择性注意力合并：儿童语音识别案例研究
items.summary: The paper introduces Selective Attention Merge, which selectively merges task vectors from attention matrices, reducing relative word error rate by up to 14% and reaching a state-of-the-art WER of 8.69 for Whisper-small on the MyST database.

items.title: Coded Deep Learning: Framework and Algorithm
items.title_zh: Coded Deep Learning：框架与算法
items.summary: The paper introduces coded deep learning, a framework that brings information-theoretic coding into model training to compress weights and activations, cut computation and support efficient parallelism. It also presents a relaxed variant and reports gains over state-of-the-art DNN compression methods.

items.title: CEReBrO: Compact Encoder for Representations of Brain Oscillations Using Efficient Alternating Attention
items.title_zh: CEReBrO：使用高效交替注意力表示脑电振荡的紧凑编码器
items.summary: The paper presents CEReBrO, a compact EEG foundation model with alternating attention that models intra-channel temporal dynamics and inter-channel spatial correlations, pretrained on over 20,000 hours of public EEG recordings.

items.title: Modeling Attention during Dimensional Shifts with Counterfactual and Delayed Feedback
items.title_zh: 维度变化下的注意力建模：反事实与延迟反馈
items.summary: The study compares two models of human attention in decision tasks: an information-theoretic metric based on memory of past experiences and iterative updating from reward prediction errors. Simulations with dimensional shifts and immediate, delayed or counterfactual feedback suggest the information-theoretic approach better accounts for human-like behavior.
